title.en: Chapter 8 — The Room That Was Changed

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: رحنا عالبيت وقت ما زوج أمها كان برا.
sentences.en: We went to the house while her stepfather was out.
Holmes examined the room inch by inch.

sentences.ar: قال: في حبل جرس معلق، بس مربوط بالهوا.
sentences.en: He said: there is a bell-rope hanging, but it is fastened to nothing.
And the bed is fixed to the floor, it does not move.

sentences.ar: وفي فتحة تهوية بتفتح على أوضة زوج أمك.
sentences.en: And there is a ventilator opening onto your stepfather’s room.
She asked: so what does it mean?

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: معناها إن إشي بينزل من هناك لهون.
sentences.en: Holmes said: it means that something comes down from there to here.
